plan.summary: Knowledge servisine website URL indexing ozelligini ekleme. Kullanici bir website URL'si verir, sistem sitemap.xml uzerinden sayfalari kesfeder, HtmlAgilityPack ile scrape eder, text cikarir, 512w/50w overlap ile chunk'lar ve OpenAI embedding uretir. Mevcut semantic + keyword search akisina sifir degisiklikle entegre olur.
plan.q_intent: PDF ve SSS yanina website indexleme eklenmesi. Sitemap-based crawl, manuel re-crawl, HtmlAgilityPack.
plan.interview_notes: Q, sitemap ile tum site taramasi istedi. Periyodik re-crawl yok (manuel). HtmlAgilityPack tercih edildi.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: POST /documents/website endpoint 202 doner ve arka planda crawl baslatir
Sitemap.xml parse edilir, sitemap index desteklenir, robots.txt Disallow kurallari uygulanir
HTML sayfalardan noise (script/style/nav/footer) temizlenir, temiz text cikarilir
Chunk'lar PDF ile ayni parametrelerde (512w/50w) uretilir
Mevcut search endpoint sifir degisiklikle website chunk'larini doner
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: RetrievalService source_type bagimsiz tum chunk'lari arar

acceptance_criteria.criterion: MaxPages cap (default 200) asiri buyuk siteleri engeller

files_changed.change: Added INV-KN-037 (invalid URL), INV-KN-038 (sitemap failed), INV-KN-039 (crawl failed)
New API contract for website indexing endpoint
WebScrapingService DI registration, POST /documents/website endpoint with SSRF guard, WebsiteIndexRequest DTO, IsRfc1918 helper
New service: sitemap parsing, robots.txt compliance, HTML scraping via HtmlAgilityPack, text chunking, rate limiting
Added SourceType to DocumentProcessJob, WebScrapingService injection, ProcessWebsiteAsync method, GenerateEmbeddingsAsync loop for 500+ chunks
Added WebScraping config section (MaxPages, PageTimeoutMs, DelayBetweenRequestsMs)

verification_questions.question: Does the sitemap parsing handle both standard urlset and sitemapindex formats, and does it fall back gracefully when no sitemap is found?
Is the SSRF guard sufficient to prevent requests to internal/loopback addresses, including IPv6 and DNS rebinding?
Does the GenerateEmbeddingsAsync loop correctly handle more than 500 chunks without missing any?
Are website crawl failures properly propagated as document status='error' without leaving orphan chunks?
Does the DocumentProcessJob.SourceType default of 'pdf' ensure backward compatibility for existing enqueued jobs?

intentional_exclusions: No UI for website submission (API-only for now)
